translate_en|mods/BanditsNPCTweaks/commo: THIS SETTING DOES NOTHING. The whole block that would do the work is commented out in the Bandits mod.
THIS SETTING DOES NOTHING. The code that would calculate and apply it is commented out in the Bandits mod, so spawning is even across the map whatever you set here.
Allow this mod's own gangs to spawn
On means the Bandits mod spawns the 36 gangs it ships with. Off leaves only bandits placed by you or by other mods. The original wording said the opposite of what this does.

How often their gunfire hits you. Every bandit gets the level you pick, whichever gang it belongs to. Varies by gang keeps the Bandits mod's own mix instead. Melee is not affected. Higher settings also fit them better scopes, so a more accurate bandit opens fire from further away. Only affects bandits that spawn after this setting is changed.
Seconds Before They Fire, Up Close
How long you get between a bandit deciding to shoot and the shot arriving, when it is within 2 tiles of you. Min 0.5, max 10, default 0.70.
Seconds Before They Fire, At Range
How long you get between a bandit deciding to shoot and the shot arriving, when it is 6 tiles or more away from you. Min 0.5, max 10, default 1.00.

Allows gangs that come looking for you and attack on sight. 17 gangs can assault. Turning this off removes only their assault behaviour. If a gang has other roles like Wanderers for example, it can still appear for those.
Allows gangs to set up forest camps. 7 gangs can camp, and this is the only way camps appear for you to loot. Turning this off removes camping only, so gangs with other roles can still appear.

A companion is a survivor who walks with you, fights whatever you fight, and gets in your car when you drive. Normally you find one and ask. Four gangs skip the asking and turn up already walking with you: the karate class, the officers, the army deserters, and the wedding party, which can be 32 people. Gangs often do two or three of these things at once. Switching this off takes away only this one, and they carry on with the rest. Turn off everything a gang does and it stops appearing altogether.

Allows bandits to spawn already inside buildings for you to encounter when you enter. 10 gangs can defend buildings. Turning this off removes building defence only, so gangs with other roles can still appear.
Allows gangs to set up roadblocks. 6 gangs can do this. Turning this off removes roadblocks only, so gangs with other roles can still appear.

Allows wandering gangs to roam the county. 18 gangs wander. Only 4 are friendly, and those 4 are the only survivors you can recruit to travel with you. Turning this off removes wandering only, so gangs with other roles can still appear.

Sets the delay after an assault gang arrives before another assault can happen. Default is No gap. Each time, the delay is randomly rolled within your chosen range. If a gang has other roles like Wanderers for example, it can still appear for those.

Controls which gang sightings are broadcast on the CB radio. Hostile and friendly announces both. Hostile only never broadcasts friendly gangs. Friendly only never broadcasts hostile gangs. This does not change which gangs spawn or how they behave. Players can still hide either type for themselves in their own radio settings.
Hours Before a Bandit Body Disappears, 0 for the Same as Zombies

How many in-game hours a dead bandit lies there before its body is cleared away. Min 0, max 720, default 0. AT 0 BANDIT BODIES GO WHEN ZOMBIE BODIES GO, because the game's own Hours For Corpse Removal setting is used instead. Any other number applies to bandit bodies only and leaves zombies alone. Bodies are only cleared while a player is nearby and that part of the map is loaded.
Master switch. Off means this mod does nothing and the Bandits mod carries on as normal.

There are 29 hostile gangs and 7 friendly gangs. Hostile gangs shoot on sight. Friendly gangs leave you alone unless attacked first. This setting decides which gangs can appear. Hostile only means no friendly gangs or companions. Friendly only means no hostile gangs, so no bandits will hunt you down.
The Bandits mod releases its 36 gangs gradually, from day 0 to day 365. This pushes that whole schedule back. At 30, a gang due on day 100 turns up on day 130 instead.

Caps how many people a friendly gang can spawn. Min 1, max 60, default 30. The default does not limit normal friendly gangs, whose largest usual size is 14. It only starts to matter if the Bandits spawn multiplier is raised above 1.

Caps how many people a hostile gang can spawn. Min 1, max 60, default 30. The default does not limit any normal hostile gang, whose largest size is 16. It only starts to matter if the Bandits spawn multiplier is raised above 1.
Stops new bandits appearing while this is turned on. Existing bandits are unaffected, and spawning resumes when you turn it off.

One frequency in MHz that carries the survivor radio, or 0 for none. Four boxes, so up to four frequencies. A radio in this game holds ten presets in total, shared with whatever stations the player has saved, so four frequencies here still leaves six free. Anything outside 88.0 to 108.0, or not on a 0.2 step, is ignored. Every radio a player opens gets these added to its preset list, so nobody has to be told the numbers. 92.0 to 92.8 are where True Music Radio puts its stations by default, so those frequencies carry music and the CB radio together. 91.8 is clear of them.
One frequency in MHz that carries the survivor radio, or 0 for none. See CB Radio Frequency 1 for the full explanation.
One frequency in MHz that carries the survivor radio, or 0 for none. See CB Radio Frequency 1 for the full explanation.
One frequency in MHz that carries the survivor radio, or 0 for none. See CB Radio Frequency 1 for the full explanation.
Only on a radio, within its range

Choose how players hear survivor broadcasts about gangs. Off disables them. Heard anywhere plays every broadcast to everyone, with or without a radio. Only on a radio requires a powered radio that is on and tuned to one of this mod's CB channels, whether carried, nearby, or in a nearby car. Only on a radio within its range also checks the radio's Range value, from 750 metres for a budget walkie talkie to 20000 for a Ham Radio. Listen-only radios use 2000. Gang arrivals also need Arrival Icon enabled on the Bandits General page.
The furthest away a bandit will open fire with a pistol or revolver, in tiles, regardless of what is fitted to the gun. Min 4, max 20, default 20.
The furthest away a bandit will open fire with a rifle, in tiles, regardless of what is fitted to the gun. Min 4, max 62, default 40.
The furthest away a bandit will open fire with a shotgun, in tiles, regardless of what is fitted to the gun. Min 4, max 16, default 16.

How long a bandit can chase and fight before tiring. Every bandit gets the level you pick, whichever gang it belongs to. Varies by gang keeps the Bandits mod's own mix instead. Below Normal they tire quickly and you get a chance to break away. Only affects bandits that spawn after this setting is changed.

How much punishment a bandit takes, measured against an ordinary zombie: Frail 1.0 times as much, Soft 1.4, Normal 1.8, Tough 2.2 and Hardened 2.6. Every bandit gets the level you pick, whichever gang it belongs to. Varies by gang keeps the Bandits mod's own mix instead. In that mix most gangs sit at 1.8 and the toughest reach 2.6. Only affects bandits that spawn after this setting is changed.
